chief_complaint: Increasing shortness of breath and fatigue over the past week, worse with exertion.

medications_prescribed.name: Warfarin
medications_prescribed.frequency: Once daily (dose adjusted based on INR)

doctor_notes: Patient presents with worsening dyspnea on exertion and orthopnea. Physical exam reveals bilateral crackles in lung bases, peripheral edema (2+), and jugular venous distension.  History of CHF, HTN, and DM2.  Current medications are being reviewed.  Considered dose adjustment for furosemide and further investigation into cardiac function.  Patient reports adherence to medications but admits to occasional dietary indiscretions.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Hello Eleanor, tell me more about this shortness of breath you've been experiencing.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: It's been getting worse, doctor. I can barely walk to the mailbox without feeling winded. And at night, I have to prop myself up with pillows to breathe.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. Have you noticed any swelling in your legs or ankles?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Yes, they do feel a bit puffy, especially by the end of the day.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Okay. We'll need to do some tests to understand what's going on. I'm going to adjust your Lasix dose and we'll monitor your electrolytes closely.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Thank you, doctor. I'm really hoping to feel better.

follow_up_actions: Follow up in 1 week for reassessment.
